name: LAS Sprint 01
goal: Accounts, privacy rules and agreed UI/UX direction. Scope and acceptance criteria: LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 02
goal: Recovery, private files, data isolation, deletion/consent, security tests and UX wireframes. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 03
goal: Audio analysis, validated DSP chain and approved design system. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 04
goal: Mastering controls, level-matched A/B, WAV export and redesigned studio shell. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 05
goal: Reference audio profiles and level-matched comparison. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 06
goal: Explainable processing proposals, preferences and reusable presets. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 07
goal: Synchronized stems, per-channel processing, advanced workflows and UX validation. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 08
goal: Evaluate AI stem separation and native plugin-host feasibility. See LAS-40.

name: LAS Sprint 09
goal: Gated plugin-host prototype and feasibility of training an audio model. See LAS-40.
